prerequisites: Basic skills in teamwork and computer applications (as a user)

learning_outcomes.text: Know FEUP and use the primary services of the Campus.
Demonstrate communication skills, including writing technical/scientific reports, creating posters, and preparing and delivering oral presentations.
Effectively participate in teamwork, including peer assessment, flexible interpersonal relationships, and respecting team rules.
Achieve the specific aims of the assigned Theme/Project.
Demonstrate awareness of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) established by the United Nations, and be able to identify sustainability principles in engineering practices.

syllabus_topics: Advanced computer tools (collaborative / web-based) such as Google Apps and Moodle
Technical work framed within the objectives for sustainable development
Formation within the subject for the Theme / Project
teaching_methods: Oral presentations and defense to a jury

assessment_methods.method: Mini Test (Individual Grade of First Week)

assessment_rules: The final mark is calculated as: Final_Mark = (5% Individual_Grade_of_First_Week) + [(45% Report) + (20% Poster) + (30% Presentation) Individual_Offset]. The Individual_Grade_of_First_Week is obtained through a Mini Test. The Individual_Offset adjusts individual performance within the team, based on peer assessment and monitor information, generally ranging between -2 and +2. Eligibility for assessment requires participation in teamwork (Theme/Project) and at least 75% of class attendance. Evaluation by exam is not possible in any official assessment periods; work on the Theme/Project is mandatory.
